g.text: Public fly-brain expression: full-cohort descriptive comparison
Three matched collection-day pools per condition, each containing three larval fly brains.
Each arm normalized separately; common-positive reference. Same detected genes outside X and 2L.
A separate post hoc check omitting collection-day pairs can reverse either correlation sign.
Cohort, age/temperature, cell composition and deposited-row selection limit transfer.
These are relative-expression summaries, not DESeq2 reproduction, drug response or patient benefit.
